title: Home practical guide and safety card: room safety check
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 38 (Home practical guide and safety card: room safety check (portal worksheet; look only, adult present))
intro: Lesson 38: Using electricity safely at home. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To check a room for electrical safety
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Walk round one room with an adult; look only, do not touch
Check for damaged cables or plugs
Check nothing electrical is near water
Check cables are not under rugs
Tell the adult about anything unsafe

questions.q: Big question: why does a plug have a fuse?
questions.a: To cut off the supply if a fault makes the current too big.
